name: compile
title: Understand a request
description: Reads a request for a list, written in everyday words in any language: companies and local businesses, products and stores, jobs, papers, clinical trials, grants, tenders, datasets, repositories and packages, apps, books or podcasts. Returns how SpecStream understood it: what to find, the conditions for every result, the facts to bring back (required or optional), how many, and in what order. The returned ast_hash identifies this reading. For a list the user has, parent_find_id and the operation add facts to it, extend it or refresh it. In that case, what it finds and its conditions stay the same, and only the new facts or the new count are read. The caller needs read access to that list. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

RetainedRequest.description:
An explicit dependency on an authorized, immutable prior research request.

The label is display text only. It never selects records or changes the target.
The server loads the actual Spec; callers cannot provide a replacement base.

name: list_spec_revisions
title: Read a request's history
description: Lists every saved version of a request.

name: get_spec_revision
title: Open one version
description: Reads one earlier version of a saved request, unchanged.

name: archive_spec
title: Archive or restore a request
description: Archives a saved request, or restores it. Its results stay.

description: Lists the runs of each version of a saved request.

name: create_project
title: Create a project
description: Creates a project with its own spending limit.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: Lists the projects the caller can open, with the caller's role in each.

name: get_project
title: Open a project
description: Reads a project, its members, their roles and their spending limits.

name: update_project
title: Update a project
description: Changes a project's details. The change fails if someone changed the project after the caller read it.

name: put_project_member
title: Set a member's role and limit
description: Sets a person's role in a project, editor or viewer, and their own monthly spending limit.

annotations.title: Set a member's role and limit

name: list_project_members
title: List project members
description: Lists the people in a project and their roles.

name: revoke_project_member
title: Remove a project member
description: Ends a person's access to a project. Their work stays.

name: get_delivery
title: Open delivered results
description: Reads a run's finished results with the request version and the sources behind them.

name: get_find_decisions
title: See why each result qualified
description: Reads each condition check on a run's results: yes, no or unsure, the value seen, and its source.

name: replay_find_decisions
title: Replay the checks
description: Reproduces a run's saved checks from the recorded evidence. No new search and no new charge.

name: get_me
title: Check spending limits
description: Reads the spending limit for this connection and how much of it is left.

name: search_workspace
title: Search your work
description: Finds records, lists, requests, projects, people, notes and monitors by name or text.

name: list_notifications
title: Read notifications
description: Reads mentions, finished work and blocked monitors.

name: list_audit_events
title: Read the audit log
description: Reads sign-ins, new keys, approved spending, exports, monitors and imports from the last 12 months.

name: get_account
title: Read the account
description: Reads the account and its payment history.

name: spec_options
title: See what you can ask for
description: Lists the conditions and facts SpecStream can check for one kind of record.

annotations.title: See what you can ask for

name: get_find_commerce
title: Check a run's payment
description: Reads what a run was charged, what it delivered, and who can open it.

name: reconcile_find_commerce
title: Recover a payment
description: Finds a payment that already happened for a run, so the work does not run again.

name: cancel_find
title: Stop a run
description: Asks a run in progress to stop. The run keeps what it already found.

name: export_find
title: Download the results
description: Creates a download link for a run's results as CSV, Excel, JSON or HTML, or as KML and GeoJSON for records with places. The link works for 24 hours.

ExportFormat.description: Owned Delivery export formats, including maps from supplied coordinates.
ExportFormat.title: ExportFormat

name: share_find
title: Share results
description: Creates a link to a fixed copy of a run's results. Anyone with the link can open it.

name: revoke_share
title: Stop sharing results
description: Turns off a shared link to a run's results or to a list.

name: get_capacity_catalog
title: Read prices
description: Reads the plans, per-result rates and top-up options.

name: get_capacity_balance
title: Check the balance
description: Reads the balance available for work. A balance is not permission to spend. Paid work starts only from a quote the user approved.

name: get_capacity_entitlements
title: Check what the plan includes
description: Reads the account's plan, what it includes, such as schedules, CRM sync and single sign-on, and how many members it has. A feature outside the plan returns plan_required with the plan that includes it.

name: claim_free_capacity
title: Claim the free start
description: Claims the one-time free balance for an eligible, verified account.

name: quote_capacity_work
title: Get a quote
description: Prices the reading identified by ast_hash before anything runs. Operation find prices a new request. Operation extend prices more results, add_facts prices more facts on results the user has, and refresh prices a recheck of them. These three take parent_find_id. For an imported list, operation find with source_import_id and its source_row_ids fills in details or checks each row. The quote shows the most the work can cost. Nothing is spent.

name: get_capacity_quote
title: Reopen a quote
description: Reads a quote and any work already approved from it.

name: authorize_capacity_work
title: Approve a quote
description: Starts the work on an approved quote. It takes the quote_id and quote_hash, the ceiling the user approved in cents as confirm_max_cents, and a stable idempotency_key. SpecStream then reads the live web and charges for delivered results at the quoted rate, plus the checks the quote lists, never more than the ceiling.

name: get_capacity_request
title: Find work already started
description: Returns the work started with an idempotency_key, so a retry does not start it twice.

name: get_capacity_execution
title: Read what a run cost
description: Reads the finished work, what it cost, and the caller's access to its results.

name: create_capacity_schedule
title: Create a monitor
description: Runs a request on a schedule, hourly to yearly, within a limit per run and per period. Each run reads the live web. A refresh bills half the rate for a changed row and 1 cent for an unchanged row. monthly_maximum_cents is the most the monitor can spend in one UTC calendar month. It equals the limit per period, and that limit covers both the scheduled runs and the runs started on demand. scheduled_monthly_cents is the most the scheduled runs alone can spend in their busiest UTC calendar month: the number of runs in that month times the limit per run, never more than the limit per period.

name: list_capacity_schedules
title: List monitors
description: Lists the account's monitors and whether each is running or paused. monthly_maximum_cents is the most a monitor can spend in one UTC calendar month, equal to its limit per period. scheduled_monthly_cents is the most its scheduled runs alone can spend in their busiest UTC calendar month.

name: update_capacity_schedule
title: Pause, resume or delete a monitor
description: Pauses, resumes or deletes a monitor. Missed runs are never bought later.

annotations.title: Pause, resume or delete a monitor

name: list_capacity_occurrences
title: See each monitor run
description: Reads a monitor's completed, blocked and missed runs, with the reason for each.

name: create_capacity_refund_claim
title: Report a wrong result
description: Sends charged results that do not meet the request's conditions for review and a refund.

name: get_capacity_refund_claim
title: Check a report
description: Reads the status of a reported wrong result.

name: create_api_key
title: Create an API key
description: Creates an API key with permissions, an expiry date and a spending limit.

name: create_webhook
title: Add a webhook
description: Adds a webhook that sends a signed event to a URL when a run finishes, a monitor finds something new, or records are added. The response shows the signing secret once.

name: delegate_access
title: Delegate a budget
description: Lets a key or project run specific work within a per-run and monthly limit.

name: request_account_deletion
title: Close the account
description: Closes the account. Access ends at once, and the data is erased seven days later.

name: invite_project_member
title: Invite someone to a project
description: Emails a project invitation with a role, a spending limit and an expiry date.

name: filter_by_area
title: Filter by map area
description: Narrows a collection to the records inside an area on the map.

name: get_input_research
title: Review imported research
description: Reads each original row of an imported list, the identity decision with its source, any unresolved namesakes and the delivered record. The name and location in the input are search hints, not verified facts. An identity without evidence stays missing and is not a Match. No charge and no new research.

name: set_schedule_delivery
title: Choose where a monitor reports
description: Sets where new and changed records go when a monitor finds them: notifications, Slack, a connected tool or a signed webhook. Nothing runs.

name: list_collections
title: List collections
description: Lists the imported lists and results the caller can open.

name: get_collection
title: Open a collection
description: Reads a collection's records, columns and saved views.

name: combine_collections
title: Combine lists
description: Merges collections the caller owns into one, and keeps each record once with its sources.

name: filter_collection
title: Narrow a list
description: Keeps the selected records of a collection, by ID, by source or by location.

name: list_views
title: List saved views
description: Lists the views saved on a collection.

name: save_view
title: Save a view
description: Saves the filters, columns, sort order and map area of a collection as a personal view.

name: list_starred
title: List starred work
description: Lists the starred requests, collections and projects.

name: star_item
title: Star something
description: Stars or unstars a request, collection or project, so it shows in the sidebar.

name: list_notes
title: Read notes
description: Reads the notes on a project or a record.

name: add_note
title: Leave a note
description: Adds a note to a project or a record. Each person the note @mentions gets an email.

name: resolve_note
title: Resolve a note
description: Marks a note done, or reopens it.

name: list_your_fields
title: Read your fields
description: Reads the status, checkbox and text fields a team added to a collection.

name: save_your_fields
title: Add, rename or remove your fields
description: Adds, renames or removes the team's own fields on a collection. Removing a field deletes its values.

annotations.title: Add, rename or remove your fields

name: set_your_field
title: Mark records
description: Sets or clears one of the team's own fields on the selected records, such as a status of Called.

name: list_connections
title: List connected tools
description: Lists the spreadsheets, databases, CRMs and automation tools this account connected.

name: list_connection_destinations
title: Pick where records go
description: Lists the sheets, tables, bases and CRM objects in a connected account.

name: get_connection_columns
title: Read a destination's fields
description: Reads the columns or properties a destination has, in the tool's own words. Nothing is sent.

name: save_connection_destination
title: Save a field mapping
description: Saves which fact goes into which field of a destination, for every later send.

name: send_to_destination
title: Send records to a tool
description: Writes the selected results to Google Sheets, Excel, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, Salesforce or Outlook drafts with the saved field mapping. A CRM updates the records it already has.

name: reconcile_destination_export
title: Check an uncertain send
description: Checks what arrived in a destination, so nothing is sent twice.

name: create_destination_sync
title: Keep a tool up to date
description: Sends new and changed records to one destination on each change, with the same mapping.

annotations.title: Keep a tool up to date

name: update_destination_sync
title: Start or stop sending
description: Starts or stops continuous sending to a destination.

name: list_destination_syncs
title: List continuous sends
description: Lists every destination that receives new records, and whether each is on.

name: list_destination_exports
title: Read what was sent
description: Reads each send: where it went, how many records arrived, and which were updated or skipped.

name: list_connected_tools
title: See tools you can connect
description: Lists the sheets, databases, CRMs, automation and chat tools SpecStream can send to.

name: import_from_source
title: Import from a connected sheet
description: Imports a Google Sheet, Excel workbook or Airtable view. It can also check the source every day for new and changed rows.

name: preview_cloud_list
title: Preview a connected sheet
description: Reads the first rows and columns of a Google Sheet, Excel workbook or Airtable view before an import.

name: list_cloud_imports
title: List linked sheets
description: Lists the linked sheets and tables, and when each was last checked.

name: update_cloud_import
title: Start or stop daily checks
description: Turns the daily check for new and changed rows on or off for a linked sheet.

name: import_csv
title: Import a CSV or Excel file
description: Imports the user's own list from a CSV or Excel file, with names, websites, places and any other columns. Nothing is researched or charged. Returns the import id, which a quote takes as source_import_id to fill in details or check each row.

annotations.title: Import a CSV or Excel file

name: list_activity
title: Read activity
description: Reads what happened across the account and its projects, and who did it.

name: get_relationships
title: See what records share
description: Groups records by the values they share in a column.

name: save_relationships
title: Connect records by a column
description: Saves the column that links records, such as a city, an owner or a supplier.

name: report_wrong_result
title: Report a result in a list
description: Reports a wrong charged result in a list, within 7 days, for review and a refund.

annotations.title: Report a result in a list

name: share_collection
title: Share a list
description: Creates a link to a fixed copy of every record in a list, such as an imported list. Anyone with the link can open it without an account. Each value keeps the source link its list gives. Nothing is charged. Returns the share id, which turns the link off.

expires_days.description: Days the link stays on. null keeps it on.
expires_days.title: Expires Days

allow_export.description: Whether people with the link can download the rows.
allow_export.title: Allow Export

name: list_request_templates
title: Start from an example
description: Lists example requests that work for each kind of record. Nothing runs from an example until a quote for it is approved.

name: get_collection_changes
title: See what changed
description: Compares a list with its earlier results: each changed fact, before and after, and where it was seen.

name: teach_web_source
title: Teach a website source
description: Reads one public page and learns its records from 3 to 8 example rows the user copied from it. Returns a preview and its explanation: how each field is read, which rows are the user's examples and which were inferred, and what happens when the page changes.

name: list_web_sources
title: List website sources
description: Lists the website sources saved in a project.

name: get_web_source
title: Read a website source
description: Reads a saved website source and how each column is read.

name: preview_web_source
title: Read a website source again
description: Reads a saved source's page again and previews its rows. Earlier lists stay unchanged.

name: get_web_source_preview
title: Read a source preview
description: Reads one source preview with its rows, cell locations and field explanations.

name: save_web_source_list
title: Save a source preview as a list
description: Saves a preview the user reviewed as an imported list, by its preview hash. Saving does not research or spend.

annotations.title: Save a source preview as a list

name: get_reconciliation_fields
title: List fields to match on
description: Reads the fields of a list the user can open, with example values, for a match against another list. Changes nothing.

name: list_reconciliations
title: List recent comparisons
description: Lists the latest comparisons that include a list. SpecStream keeps a comparison for 30 days. A list filled from a comparison stays as its own list.

name: prepare_reconciliation
title: Compare two lists
description: Proposes which rows in one list correspond to rows in another list. It takes matching groups of exact or close-spelling rules, and conflict fields that rule a pair out. A pair matches when every rule in one group agrees. Returns the proposed pairs, alternatives, conflicts and missing values. A close spelling is not proof of the same company, and a single candidate is not a chosen pair. No search and no charge.

name: get_reconciliation
title: Read a comparison
description: Reads the proposed pairs, alternatives, conflicts and missing values of a comparison. Returns an error if either list changed after the comparison was prepared.

name: apply_reconciliation
title: Fill a list from chosen pairs
description: Fills empty cells into a new list from the counterpart rows of the pairs the user chose. It takes the exact comparison hash. Original cells and lists stay unchanged, and unmatched rows stay in the new list. Filled cells are inputs, not checked results. Research on them needs a normal quote and approval.

annotations.title: Fill a list from chosen pairs

name: get_reconciled_input
title: Read where filled cells came from
description: Reads, for a list filled from a comparison, which chosen pair filled each cell.

annotations.title: Read where filled cells came from

name: list_investigation_functions
title: List requests that run per row
description: Lists the saved requests in a project that can run once per row.

annotations.title: List requests that run per row

name: create_investigation_function
title: Make a request run per row
description: Makes a saved request run once per row, with some of its values as typed inputs. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

annotations.title: Make a request run per row

name: get_investigation_function
title: Read a request that runs per row
description: Reads a saved request that runs per row, and its typed inputs.

annotations.title: Read a request that runs per row

name: get_investigation_parameters
title: List a request's possible inputs
description: Lists the values in a saved request that can become inputs.

name: get_investigation_inputs
title: List a list's columns for inputs
description: Lists the columns of a list with example values, for the choice of which column feeds each input.

annotations.title: List a list's columns for inputs

name: list_collection_investigations
title: List runs over a list
description: Lists the recent runs started from a list.

name: prepare_investigation_batch
title: Quote a run over list rows
description: Binds the selected rows to the inputs and returns one quote: the distinct searches, rows with missing inputs, searches reused from earlier work, and one maximum. Nothing runs yet.

annotations.title: Quote a run over list rows

name: get_investigation_batch
title: Read a run over list rows
description: Reads each input row, its search status and the list it led to.

annotations.title: Read a run over list rows

name: approve_investigation_batch
title: Approve a run over list rows
description: Approves the quote's exact maximum. The searches then run as ordinary finds, within that maximum.

annotations.title: Approve a run over list rows

name: cancel_investigation_batch
title: Stop a run over list rows
description: Stops searches that did not start, and cancels running ones where possible. Finished results stay with the user.

annotations.title: Stop a run over list rows

name: get_investigation_results
title: Read a run's results by row
description: Reads each input row with the results it led to, and their sources. Input values are never sources for results.

annotations.title: Read a run's results by row

name: prepare_research_rule
title: Prepare automatic research
description: Prepares a rule that researches rows when they first become ready or when their inputs change, with a per-run and a total spending limit. Nothing runs until the rule is approved.

name: list_research_rules
title: List automatic research rules
description: Lists the automatic research rules on a list.

name: get_research_rule
title: Read an automatic research rule
description: Reads a rule's limits, what it spent, which rows are waiting, and its recent runs.

name: approve_research_rule
title: Approve automatic research
description: Approves the rule's total spending limit. Rows that qualify later then run with no new approval, until the rule reaches the limit or the expiry.

name: patch_research_rule
title: Pause, resume or delete a rule
description: Pauses, resumes or deletes a rule. A pause holds queued searches, and running searches finish. A resume never raises the limits.

annotations.title: Pause, resume or delete a rule

name: get_research_rule_results
title: Read automatic research results
description: Reads every run of the rule with its input rows and results.
